name: net-18
note: Plain CRC with no re-read: long.inc 1353 bytes, several 512-byte reads, 644F7FB6; short.inc 3 bytes, 0A6337A8. Pass: engine matches, so the stream buffer is aligned and the unaligned re-read never fires on files. Raw-buffer callers with unaligned pointers stay untested. A fail is not by itself proof of misalignment: compare with net-17 first.
